title: Triage framework: enterprise Private/VPC/on-prem requests with air-gapped and upgrade constraints
creator: Lina Morales
description: We are seeing an uptick in inbound enterprise requests for Private/VPC and on‑prem deployments that include strict networking constraints (e.g., egress blocked, proxy-only updates), air‑gapped upgrade windows, and nonstandard KMS/HSM integrations. These requests are currently handled ad hoc by solutions engineering and account teams, which causes long lead times and inconsistent risk assessments. This ticket is to build a repeatable triage and prioritization framework that product management can use to: 1) capture the required info up front, 2) surface security/compliance blockers early, 3) estimate engineering change effort and release impact, and 4) give account teams a predictable intake SLA.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable intake checklist (confluence template) that captures networking topology, allowed egress, upgrade cadence, KMS/HSM requirements, and data residency requirements
A prioritization rubric with clear scoring for customer size, compliance risk, revenue potential, and engineering effort
Documented handoff process between Solutions Engineering, PM, Security, and Engineering that includes SLA targets for initial triage (48h) and estimate (10 business days)
Pilot the intake flow with two active enterprise accounts and capture feedback from SE and Eng teams
All items required for a security review are flagged automatically and routed to Security with a clear checklist
triage_steps: Step 1: Initial intake form (completed by AE/SE) using the confluence template; must include: network diagram, egress policy, patch/update window, airgap justification, and KMS details
Step 2: PM review within 48 hours — validate completeness; if incomplete, return to AE/SE with list of missing items
Step 3: Security screening: automatically assign to security triage queue if sample data includes PHI/PII or on-prem requires HSM integration
Step 4: Engineering feasibility check (small spike <= 3 days) focused on upgrade path and packaging constraints (container vs. appliance), outcome: feasible / feasible with changes / blocking
Step 5: Estimate and priority score assigned; route to roadmap or backlog with stakeholder communication template
prioritization_rubric: Revenue: 0-5 points (based on ARR or contract potential)
Compliance/Risk: 0-5 points (airgap required + regulatory burden increases score)
Engineering effort: 0-5 points (lower score = less effort, used to compute schedule impact)
Strategic fit: 0-3 points (aligns with Private/VPC roadmap and platform goals)
Score interpretation: >=12 => candidate for prioritized roadmap slot; 8-11 => backlog with SLA; <8 => self-serve or professional services
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Decision: Use a lightweight confluence form for intake to avoid building a full new UI in first iteration. Tradeoff: manual copying into tracking board initially will be required.
Decision: Require a security checklist early for any air‑gapped requests. Tradeoff: may slow initial intake but reduces late-stage blockers and rework.

Tradeoff: Offer 'professional services' as a fast-path for time-sensitive customers vs. building full platform support; professional services can be revenue-generating but reduces productization pressure.
Decision: Engineering feasibility spikes are capped at 3 days to avoid long discovery cycles; if unresolved, escalate to an exec review.
Risk: Some large customers will demand bespoke upgrade tooling; we will document supported vs. unsupported upgrade patterns and charge for customization beyond supported patterns
next_actions: Create confluence intake template and link to AE/SE playbook (Owner: PM)
Work with Security to assemble the minimal security checklist for air-gapped/on‑prem installs (Owner: Security)
Create a short SE enablement doc and an email/Slack template for intake responses (Owner: Solutions Engineering)
Run two pilot intakes with AE/SE on active deals this week and gather feedback (Owner: PM)
Schedule a 1-hour cross-functional review meeting (PM, Security, Eng leads, SE) to approve rubric and SLAs
